title: Sakina Sojao Sakina Sojao
body:
SAKINA SOJAO SAKINA SOJAO
Zinda Mai Zainab Kheti Thi
Aey Meri Sakina Aey Beti
Goud Me Aaha O Sakina Sojao
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh Chhera Kyoun Hai Zard Kaho
Kaisa Hai Galeka Dard Kaho
Kuchto Batla O Sakina Sojao
Phat Tha Hai Jigar Ithnabhi Na Ro
<<DIVIDER>>
Ma Sabr Kare Kyoun Karbobala
Ab Aur Na Tadpa O Sakina Sojao Kyun Karti Ho Tum Ranj O Mehan
Chahe To Khuda Jainge Watan
Kuch Din Hai Tahair Jaa O Sakina Sojao
<<DIVIDER>>
Ammu Bhi Tumhare Qatl Huye
Ab Kayoun Bhala Imdad Kare
Aey Bibi Na Ghabrao Sakina Sojao
Tum Rotiho Kunba Rota Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Shor Buka Ka Hota Hai
Tum Roke Na Rulawa O Sakina Sojao
Ab Seena Kahan Hai Baba Ka
Pamal Jua Ranme Laasha
<<DIVIDER>>
Aagosh Me Aaja O Sakina Sojao
Zindan Me Har Dam Kehthi Thi
Aey Akbar O Razvi Binte Ali
Gurbat Ka Na Gham Khao Sakina Sojao
